description: Header-matched story identities and original spoiler-free summaries. No story code or transcripts.

stories.title: A Mind Forever Voyaging
stories.summary: Explore simulated futures as PRISM, a sentient computer investigating how a proposed political programme changes everyday life.

stories.title: Arthur: The Quest for Excalibur
stories.summary: Become the young Arthur, explore a magical Britain and prove yourself worthy of the sword and the throne.

stories.title: Ballyhoo
stories.summary: Stay behind after a circus performance and investigate a disappearance among performers with secrets of their own.

stories.title: Beyond Zork: The Coconut of Quendor
stories.summary: Explore a changing fantasy landscape, develop your character and seek a powerful relic in a mixture of adventure and role-playing.

stories.title: Bureaucracy
stories.summary: A change of address spirals into absurd obstacles, obstructive institutions and escalating frustration in this comic adventure.

stories.title: Cutthroats
stories.summary: Join a dangerous salvage expedition, dive for sunken treasure and decide whom to trust above and below the water.

stories.title: Deadline
stories.summary: Investigate a suspicious death at a country estate. Question the household, follow changing events and assemble evidence before time runs out.

stories.title: Enchanter
stories.summary: A novice magician must face a dangerous sorcerer, learning spells and using an expanding spellbook to solve magical problems.

stories.title: Generic
stories.summary: A small game-development template containing a parser, sample rooms and objects. This is development material rather than a finished adventure.

stories.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
stories.summary: Join Arthur Dent for an absurd journey through space after an ordinary morning takes a very unfortunate turn.

stories.title: Hollywood Hijinx
stories.summary: Explore an eccentric movie producer's mansion and its elaborate puzzles while trying to claim a most unusual inheritance.

stories.title: Zork experiment (Tomas Bok)
stories.summary: This build is a heavily modified Zork experiment grouped with the Hypochondriac files. It is not the later Hypochondriac game.

stories.title: Infidel
stories.summary: An abandoned expedition leaves you searching the Egyptian desert for a hidden pyramid and the treasures within.

stories.title: Journey
stories.summary: Guide a party of travellers through a threatened fantasy world, choosing actions and managing the companions' different talents.

stories.title: Leather Goddesses of Phobos
stories.summary: Escape alien captivity and travel between strange worlds in a comic science-fiction adventure with selectable levels of adult humour.

stories.title: The Lurking Horror
stories.summary: A late-night visit to a university computer room becomes an investigation of disturbing events beneath the campus.

stories.title: Mini-Zork I
stories.summary: Explore a compact adaptation of Zork's underground world, solving puzzles and searching for treasures in a shortened adventure.

stories.title: Moonmist
stories.summary: Visit a Cornish castle, investigate a haunting and untangle the secrets of its inhabitants in a mystery with several variations.

stories.title: Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It
stories.summary: Solve a collection of surreal situations by playing with puns, idioms and the literal meanings of familiar expressions.

stories.title: Planetfall
stories.summary: A shipboard disaster strands a low-ranking space sailor on an unfamiliar planet, where a friendly robot offers unexpected companionship.

stories.title: The Restaurant at the End of the Universe
stories.summary: An incomplete, unreleased follow-up to The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy. Expect prototype content rather than a complete adventure.

stories.title: Infocom Sampler
stories.summary: A tutorial and short samples from Zork I, Planetfall, Infidel and The Witness. These are excerpts, not four complete games.

stories.title: Seastalker
stories.summary: Pilot a small submarine, investigate a threat to an underwater research station and uncover a mystery beneath the sea.

stories.title: Sherlock: The Riddle of the Crown Jewels
stories.summary: Assist Sherlock Holmes as Dr Watson in a London investigation involving missing royal jewels and a series of riddles.

stories.title: James Clavell's Shogun
stories.summary: Follow an English navigator drawn into the rivalries and unfamiliar customs of feudal Japan in an adaptation of the novel.

stories.title: Sorcerer
stories.summary: Search for a missing master magician, collecting spells and facing strange hazards in the second Enchanter adventure.

stories.title: Spellbreaker
stories.summary: Investigate a crisis in magic itself, travelling between unusual places and solving the final challenges of the Enchanter trilogy.

stories.title: Starcross
stories.summary: A space prospector encounters an enormous alien vessel. Explore its habitats and learn how its mysterious machinery works.

stories.title: Stationfall
stories.summary: An apparently routine space-station errand turns dangerous. Reunite with Floyd and investigate what has happened to the crew.

stories.title: Suspect
stories.summary: A costume party becomes a murder investigation, and you are under suspicion. Observe the guests and establish what really happened.

stories.title: Suspended
stories.summary: Direct robots with different senses and abilities to repair a failing planetary system while your own body remains immobilised.

stories.title: Trinity
stories.summary: A London holiday gives way to a surreal journey through places connected with nuclear history, linked by a strange central world.

stories.title: Wishbringer
stories.summary: A simple postal delivery becomes a rescue mission in a transformed town, with a mysterious stone offering limited magical help.

stories.title: The Witness
stories.summary: Visit a wealthy businessman in 1930s California, witness a crime and investigate the people and evidence surrounding it.

stories.title: ZipTest
stories.summary: An interpreter regression suite for version 6 Z-code. It exercises machine behaviour rather than providing a conventional adventure.

stories.title: Zork Zero: The Revenge of Megaboz
stories.summary: Explore the Great Underground Empire before the original Zork, tackling a jester's challenges and a far-reaching curse.

stories.title: Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
stories.summary: Enter the world beneath a white house, discover an underground empire and solve puzzles while collecting its treasures.

stories.title: Zork II: The Wizard of Frobozz
stories.summary: Continue deeper into the Great Underground Empire, where a capricious wizard and strange mechanisms obstruct your exploration.

stories.title: Zork III: The Dungeon Master
stories.summary: Explore the final regions of the underground empire and face tests of judgement on the path to the Dungeon Master.

stories.title: The Lantern Room
stories.summary: An original miniature adventure for trying movement, portable saves and Continue. All content is CC0.

stories.title: The Lantern Room
stories.summary: An original miniature adventure for trying movement, portable saves and Continue. All content is CC0.

stories.title: Graphics and Sound Lab
stories.summary: An original CC0 test of pictures, window layouts, character graphics, sound and timed input.

stories.title: Speaker Check
stories.summary: An original CC0 speaker check. Press P for three tones, use the app menu to test Mute, and Q to finish.

stories.title: The Abyss
stories.summary: Explore a surviving fragment of Bob Bates' planned adventure based on the underwater film. This is an incomplete project, not a finished game.

stories.summary: Become the young Arthur, explore a magical Britain and prove yourself worthy of the sword and the throne.

stories.title: Border Zone
stories.summary: Follow three linked viewpoints in a tense Cold War espionage story where the clock keeps running while you decide what to do.

stories.title: Hypochondriac
stories.summary: An unfinished personal adventure project by Tomas Bok. This release is Hypochondriac itself; the earlier files grouped with it are experiments based on other games.
